title: Process
description: One company process (for example: request a GCP project). A process has prerequisites, actors (swim lanes) and steps connected by `next` links.

id.description: Unique kebab-case id of the process, e.g. "request-gcp-project". Also used as the file name.

title.description: Short name starting with a verb, e.g. "Request a GCP project".

summary.description: One or two sentences: what the reader gets at the end and when to use this process.

category.description: Grouping shown in the library, e.g. "Cloud", "API", "Network", "Source control", "General".

owner.description: Id of the team (from the teams list) that owns and maintains this process.

tiers.description: Ids of the application tiers this process applies to, e.g. ["tier-0", "tier-1"]. Leave out when it applies to ALL tiers.

estimatedDuration.description: Typical end-to-end lead time in plain words, e.g. "3-5 working days".

prerequisites.description: Everything that must be true or available BEFORE step 1. Use an empty array if there is none.

actors.description: Who takes part. Each actor is one swim lane. The FIRST actor must always have id "me" - the person reading and following the process.

steps.description: Steps in reading order. The first step is the start. A step with an empty `next` array ends the process.

id.description: Kebab-case id referenced by steps, e.g. "platform-team".

description.description: Who this is and how to reach them.

teamId.description: Id of the team (from the teams list) when this actor is a known team.

title.description: What you must have, e.g. "Approved cost centre".

description.description: Why it is needed or how to check you have it.

processId.description: Id of another process that produces this prerequisite, if one exists.

id.description: Kebab-case id, unique within the process, e.g. "raise-request".

title.description: Short imperative phrase, e.g. "Fill in the ServiceNow request".

actor.description: Id of the actor who performs this step.

type.description: Kind of work. Decides the visual block.

description.description: One to three sentences of context: what happens and why.

instructions.description: Exact things to do, one action per item, in order. Include field values, names and commands where known.

tool.description: Id of the system used, taken from the tools list, e.g. "servicenow". Leave out if no listed tool fits.

url.description: Direct link to the form, repository or page.

duration.description: Typical time, e.g. "10 min" or "up to 2 working days".

outcome.description: What exists when this step is done, e.g. "Request number RITMxxxxxxx".

subProcessId.description: Id of another process that explains this step in detail. Required when type is "subprocess".

next.description: Steps that follow. Empty = the process ends here. A decision has two or more entries, each with a label.

label.description: Condition for this path, e.g. "Approved" or "Rejected".
